Garden journal

Your story starts here

    Small seeds. Slow moments. Good things growing.

    Reads Squeekchain's public API. No wallet, no gas, nothing is signed.

    One hamster. Nine little plots.

    A garden at hamster speed

    Pick a seed, then select an empty plot. Squeektoshi's real wheel passes grow your crops, even while you're away.

    1. 1

      Plant a little possibility

      Radish seeds are free. Earn crumbs to unlock new seeds and buy more plots.

    2. 2

      Let him do his thing

      Running grows the garden. Napping pauses it. There are no real-time countdowns.

    3. 3

      Pick something good

      Select a glowing ripe crop to harvest. Harvest during a run for 2× crumbs and a 15% golden chance.

    A little golden luck

    A golden crop adds 5× to the fresh reward: 10× its base selling price. Nap-time harvests earn the base price.

    Live data refreshes every 15 seconds. A stale signal pauses growth and fresh bonuses. Counter restarts keep your progress. Your garden is saved in this browser; clearing site data removes it.

    Demo mode simulates runs and naps in a separate garden. You can return to your live garden at any time.
